claim_namespace_map.rule: Every claim join and every T09/T10/T11 disposition must resolve through the canonical_claim_id row; implicit numeric or prose joins are forbidden.

coarse_required_before_rule: The required_before enum in change.json supplies timing only. This file supplies normative applicability. Tests executed through B3 are construct, integrity, DEV, falsification, or descriptive checks; they cannot convert a deferred conceptual claim into current evidence. An inapplicable future-stage test cannot block the B3/deferred disposition.

status_semantics.PASS: The applicable B3 construct/integrity/DEV/descriptive requirement passed; this is not a scientific claim.
status_semantics.NOT_RUN: An applicable authorized stage did not run; no scientific claim is available.
status_semantics.DEFERRED_NEW_PREREGISTRATION: Mandatory terminal status after B3; any population claim needs a fresh human-ratified proposal using untouched roots.
status_semantics.NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D: Passing not-applicable disposition for every deferred text claim; no Stage-D artifact is required and the B3/deferred disposition is not blocked.

required_for_b3_descriptive_package: all preassigned A4 rows are present in the unchanged 908-row roster
A4 V is scored only from legal world/action trajectory and terminal return for every arm
A4 failures remain zero in assigned denominators
A4 evaluation is sterile and target/truth/result leakage fails closed

tests.future_lora_claim: mandatory only if a future separately ratified DEFERRED_ASSOCIATIVE_LORA_PREREGISTRATION names it as a component control before that LoRA claim; it is not the successor headline
